`interface IHoverElement`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`PositionedHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/positionedhoverelement/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.hover` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IHoverElement.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/hover/IHoverElement.java)

A tooltip element that draws itself while its node is hovered.

## Description

Add one with [`Node.hover`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-property-hover); [`NodeHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/nodehoverelement/) and [`CustomHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/customhoverelement/) place an element at the mouse, on the node or at a fixed point.
A lambda gives `render` only: it gets the pointer position and draws where it chooses, in the coordinates of the canvas.

## Learn more

- [Hover and tooltips](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#show-a-tooltip)
